name: dore-memory
description: Local long-term memory shared by all Claude Code sessions and projects (dore): learns facts, standing rules (trusted once repeated in other words) and updates from plain chat, checked by a small Claude Haiku batch at session ends; ~11 tokens per prompt on average. Notes are stored only on this machine. After a session, what you typed (with a few close notes) goes to Claude Haiku through your own claude login; once a day a version check to npm (off with DORE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1).
